explained.allofthem: Qt RegionEditor combine choice 'All of them'; emtk's shared RegionControls offers the same rule as the combine choice 'and'.
explained.anyofthem: Qt RegionEditor combine choice 'Any of them'; emtk: combine choice 'or'.
explained.average: an option of a Qt choice list; emtk's field lists the same options when it is opened (the capture shows the lists closed; each is picked in the tests).
explained.blur: normalisation option of the Qt ImageView
explained.cividis: colormap menu entry of the Qt ImageView, not offered by the shared ImageCanvas
explained.combine: Qt RegionEditor combine label; emtk: 'Combine regions'.
explained.disk: an option of a Qt choice list; emtk's field lists the same options when it is opened (the capture shows the lists closed; each is picked in the tests).
explained.divide: normalisation option of the Qt ImageView
explained.epsilon: an option of a Qt choice list; emtk's field lists the same options when it is opened (the capture shows the lists closed; each is picked in the tests).
explained.exactlyone: Qt RegionEditor combine choice 'Exactly one'; emtk: combine choice 'xor'.
explained.frame: frame label of the Qt ImageView normalisation
explained.frame_mean: an option of a Qt choice list; emtk's field lists the same options when it is opened (the capture shows the lists closed; each is picked in the tests).
explained.gateregions: Qt title of the region list; emtk's shared region list has its own header 'Analysis regions'.
explained.gaussian: an option of a Qt choice list; emtk's field lists the same options when it is opened (the capture shows the lists closed; each is picked in the tests).
explained.gray: in emtk's colormap list (shown when opened)
explained.inferno: in emtk's colormap list (shown when opened)
explained.measurement: column header of the Qt region table (area / mean); emtk shows the area and mean of the selected region only for image regions, not for plane regions.
explained.menu: pyqtgraph ImageView Menu button (ROI / normalisation options).
explained.moving_average: an option of a Qt choice list; emtk's field lists the same options when it is opened (the capture shows the lists closed; each is picked in the tests).
explained.n: an option of a Qt choice list; emtk's field lists the same options when it is opened (the capture shows the lists closed; each is picked in the tests).
explained.noregions: Qt placeholder 'No regions'; emtk shows the selection summary line ('N of M px') instead.
explained.off: normalisation 'off' option of the Qt ImageView
explained.operation: pyqtgraph ImageView normalisation (subtract/divide/blur of a frame range): a display tool, not part of the analysis.
explained.pixel_mean: an option of a Qt choice list; emtk's field lists the same options when it is opened (the capture shows the lists closed; each is picked in the tests).
explained.plasma: colormap menu entry of the Qt ImageView, not offered by the shared ImageCanvas
explained.region: column header of the Qt region table; emtk lists each region as a selectable row with Enabled and Invert boxes.
explained.roi: pyqtgraph ImageView ROI button (line-profile ROI of the viewer); the emtk image has none.
explained.shape: column header of the Qt region table (Rectangle / Ellipse / Polygon); emtk names the shape in the region's row and its Add buttons.
explained.t: axis label (frame index) of the Qt ImageView; the emtk movie has Play, Loop, Stop and a frame slider
explained.timerange: time-range widget of the Qt ImageView normalisation
explained.total_mean: an option of a Qt choice list; emtk's field lists the same options when it is opened (the capture shows the lists closed; each is picked in the tests).
explained.turbo: colormap menu entry of the Qt ImageView, not offered by the shared ImageCanvas
explained.viridis: colormap menu of the Qt ImageView; the shared emtk ImageCanvas offers magma, inferno, viridis and gray
explained.x: axis letters of the Qt viewer; emtk draws 'x [px]' and 'y [px]'
explained.y: axis letters of the Qt viewer; emtk draws 'x [px]' and 'y [px]'
